**What you want, and why**

**Where it would live**

Capture (sensors/connectors), the brain (runner/prompts/instruments), the
CLI/server, or docs. Note: nothing in the capture path may call a model —
that boundary is not up for extension (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Would you implement it?**

Provider work (new model backends for the brain) is the most-wanted
contribution — see ROADMAP.md.
